Everything you need to manage your Mac

Eight powerful tools in one app - clean, update, uninstall, deduplicate, reset, shred, analyze, and monitor.

Smart Cleanup

Deep clean your Mac by removing system caches, logs, temp files, and app leftovers from 200+ hidden locations.

App Updater

Keep all your apps up to date in one place. Detects updates from the App Store, Homebrew, and Sparkle automatically.

Complete Uninstaller

Remove apps and every hidden leftover - preferences, caches, containers, and support files. Zero leftovers.

Duplicate Finder

Scan for duplicate files across your Mac. Content-based matching finds identical copies wasting your disk space.

App Resetter

Reset any app to factory state without reinstalling. Clears preferences, caches, and saved data in one click.

Secure Shredder

Permanently destroy sensitive files beyond recovery. AES-256 encryption and multi-pass overwriting ensure deleted data can never be restored.

Disk Space Analyzer

Visualize what's eating your disk with an interactive treemap. Drill into any folder, spot the biggest space hogs, and delete files directly.

Health Dashboard

Monitor CPU, memory, and disk usage in real-time with a clear health score. Keep your Mac running at peak performance.
